question: (i) Which part of the electromagnetic spectrum is detected by the human eye? (ii) State its approximate wavelength range. (iii) How does its frequency compare with infrared rays?

options.A:
(i) Visible light is detected by the human eye.
(ii) Its approximate wavelength range is $7.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$ to $4.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$.
(iii) Visible light has higher frequency than infrared rays because its wavelength is shorter.
options.B:
(i) Infrared radiation is detected by the human eye.
(ii) Its range is $7.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$ to $4.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$.
(iii) It has lower frequency than infrared rays.
options.C:
(i) Ultraviolet radiation is detected by the human eye.
(ii) Its range is $4.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$ to $7.0\times10^{-7}\text{ m}$.
(iii) It has lower frequency than infrared rays.
options.D:
(i) Visible light is detected by the human eye.
(ii) Its wavelength range is $7.0\times10^{-3}\text{ m}$ to $4.0\times10^{-3}\text{ m}$.
(iii) It has lower frequency than infrared rays.
